title: വയറിളക്കം ആണ് ഷിഗല്ല Shigella Outbreak & Safety Tips Malayalam | Symptoms & Prevention
description:
Welcome back to the channel! In this video, we are discussing the 'Shigella' bacterial infection, which is a critical public health concern. What is Shigella? How does it spread, and what are its major symptoms? We also cover essential prevention tips and food safety practices to keep you and your family safe.

Shigella is a highly contagious bacterium primarily transmitted through contaminated food and water. Maintaining strict personal hygiene and food safety is key to preventing this infection. Watch the full video to understand the science behind it and stay safe!

Don't forget to Like, Share, and Subscribe for more educational and science-based content.

Kiyoshishiga was a person who was very interested in the theories of Robert Koch, who is considered the father of germology or the pioneer of modern medicine .
